Cells size of Scenedesmus increased as nutrient concentration decreased, becoming larger when NP nutrients limited. However, Microcystis cells size was not changed so significantly as Scenedesmus, and difference of which was no more than 3 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with whatever nutrient availability. Analysis of the results indicated that competition between the two algae was related to pulses under different nutrient limits. According to theory of gleaner-opportunist trade-off, Microcystis showed the characteristics of an "opportunist" and Scenedesmus was more likely to be a "gleaner". The symbiosis of two bloom species coincided with the Intermediate Disturbance Hypothesis (IDH). The two algae might change their cell size and shape to strive for more nutrients.

articleTitle: Waste Heat Utilization Technology of Artesian Well Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In the oil-field artesian well process, the ejected smoke temperature of the diesel engine is generally very high, this resulted in a great deal of loss with hot ejected smoke. Aim at this problem, put forward to settle the waste heat recovery project that a heat exchanger is installed after the diesel engine muffler. The thesis passes an actual circumstance of investigate the artesian well diesel engine, making use of experience work data of the artesian well diesel engine to compute the ejected smoke temperature of the diesel engine and the relation of the efficiency, the ejected smoke quantity and enthalpy of the smoke etc., completing the burnable calculation of the artesian well diesel engine, carrying on changing the hot machine design calculation, and draw CAD diagram, and to under different burden changed hot function to carry on an evaluation, draw up calculator procedure. Compute the result confirm that project is viable, can provide around 100 °C life using water, having certain practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel Algorithm of Salient Features Extraction for Nature Scene Recognition
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: To satisfy real-time requirement of mobile robot' scene recognition, the parallel algorithms of salient features extraction are designed and implemented. Firstly, the parallel characters of salient features extraction are analyzed. Then, two parallel algorithms are presented based on multi-core and GPU respectively. Experiments show that multi-core parallel algorithm can satisfy real-time requirement and has simple implementation.

articleTitle: Research on the Performance of Novel Porous Fence
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: A new type of porous fence called Deflector-Porous Fence (DPF), which contains deflectors with different angels, has been developed. This paper studies numerically the velocity, surface pressure and turbulence intensity distribution behind the novel wind fence using FLUENT software, while comparing its characteristics with the conventional fence. The validity of the numerical method has been evaluated by comparing the simulation results with the wind-tunnel experimental data. As a result, the numerical predictions show good agreement with the experimental results. The deflectors on the novel porous fence play a good role on guiding the bleed flow to be a parabolic motion. It also shows that the novel porous fence with smaller velocity, pressure drop and turbulence intensity has better performance than the conventional one.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Signal Control Base on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Traffic signal is a measure of traffic command, which distributes right of way to the triffic flow in time domain. Through comparative study between RBF network and BP network, this paper has selected RBF network to control the trffic single. Green Light Interval is decided by the measurement parameters of detector in the actuated signal control. In the usually, the time phase number of the system is set beforehand. When there is not demand for the vehicles passing in the direction of red light, the green light phase works continuly. The system starts the control model until there is demand for the vehicles passing in the direction of red light. The paper builds the model base on radial basis function, simulates in MATLAB and make an analysis of the simulated results.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Phenolic Wastewater by Electrochemical Catalysis Oxidation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The treatment of simulated wastewater containing phenol by electrochemical catalysis oxidation in two-dimensional electro bath is studied. Factors affecting the removal efficiency of hydroquinone are investigated by static experiment, such as electrolyte concentration, electrolysis voltage, air supply and initial pH value. The results showed, with the increasing of electrolyte concentration, the removal rate of hydroquinone first increased, then decreased, with the applied voltage increased, the removal of hydroquinone has be increased. It is helpful for hydroquinone removal in the mild acid, neutral and mild base conditions. The removal rate is highest in the mild base condition. When the electrolyte concentration of Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> is 0.04mol·L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, the voltage is 5V, air supply is 80L·h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, pH is 8.5, the removal rate of hydroquinone is 85.50%.

articleTitle: Application on the Water Tree Characteristic Current Detection in XLPE Power Cable with Duffing Chaotic Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: On-line Detection is very important for XLPE Power Cables safety running. The AC Superposition Method is efficient method for XLPE Power Cables' water tree deterioration detection. Its key problem is the precision measuring of the weak 1Hz characteristic current that is the token of water tree deterioration. In this paper, theory of controlling chaos is introduced to the XLPE Power Cables water tree characteristic current detection and a special chaotic system is put forward to precise measure the 1Hz characteristic current, which based on that the Duffing chaos oscillation is respond sensitively to the "same frequency" periodic signal and immunity to the "biggish frequency difference" periodic signal with the periodic instigated force. The results of experiment show that the chaotic system can effectively to detect the 1Hz characteristic current precisely and sensitively.

articleTitle: A Fusion Method of Heterogeneous Information for Sea-surface Wireless Sensor Networks Positioning
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: To solve the precise positioning issue of underwater maneuver targets (UMTs), based on sea-surface wireless sensor networks (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>WSN) technique, this paper proposes a new positioning algorithm without exterior satellite-based or earth-based wireless navigation information as well as underwater space-time datum. The measure equations of UMT's positioning are assembled by combining the relative radio ranges among ships with the angles of arrivals (AOAs) from UMT. Meanwhile, Helmert variance estimation technology is utilized to resolve the mismatch problem of weight ratio in heterogeneous information fusion between radio range and AOAs. Monte Carlo simulation shows that the bias of the proposed algorithm, in which the weight of heterogeneous information is adaptively adjusted by Helmert technology.

articleTitle: The Determination of Components and Parameters for the Oxidation Ditch ASM1 Model of Handan
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Stoichiometric coefficient and model wastewater characterisation have a wide range in ASM1 model. In this study, COD is based on oxygen utilization rating method to characterise the soluble and particulate fractions. With biological respiration measurement, sensitive indicators of water parameters were measured, and satisfied simulation results was achieved. For example in Handan East Wastewater Treatment Plant, readily biodegradable organic matter SS, soluble inert organic matter SI, slow biodegradable organic matter XS, particulate inert organic matter XI, active heterotrophic bacteria biosolids XBH were measured which in the percentage of the total COD separately were 17.72%, 6.74%, 35.06%, 31.35%, 9.13%. The result laid the foundation for model application and simulation of oxidation ditch.

articleTitle: New Stability Criteria for Neural Networks with Time-varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The problem of delay-dependent asymptotic stability criteria for neural networks with time-varying delays is investigated. An improved delay dependent stability criteria are obtained in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) to ensure a large upper bound for time-delay. A new class of Lyapunov functional is constructed and the known bounds of the delay interval is split in two subintervals to derive some novel delay dependent stability criteria. Finally, three numerical examples are given that our results are less conservative than some existing ones.

articleTitle: Simulated Detection of VCHs in Soil by Using a Self-made Electronic Nose
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: An electronic nose principally composed of a photo ionization detector (PID) was developed for rapid detection of volatile chlorinated hydrocarbons (VCHs) in contaminated soil. Interference gases such as benzene homologues were removed with a halogenated hydrocarbon RAE-SEP tube and the removal effect was estimated with gas chromatography (GC). Different concentrations of perchloroethylene (PCE) and trichloroethylene (TCE) gases were used to evaluate the precision and reproducibility of electronic nose by comparing with GC. On these bases, ventilation purification experiments of contamination soil were simulated with three typical paddy soils in Yangtze River delta region. Results showed that RAE-SEP tube was effective to remove interference gases, with 80~97% of benzene homologues being removed and at the same time more than 90% of VCHs passed through. With PCE or TCE gas, a linear dependence was derived between the data got by electronic nose and GC, the slope is near 1.0 and the correlation coefficient R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>>;0.99. Electronic nose showed data consistency with GC (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>>;0.99, n=47)when used for soil ventilation process monitoring. Therefore, electronic nose is applicable for rapid determination of soil pollution by VCHs, improving the efficiency of pollution diagnosis and remediation.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Digital Optical Transceiver for Control of PTZ
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: A small digital optical transceiver (DOT) used to control the PTZ (Pan/Tilt/Zoom) is specially designed and produced in this paper. With a high using value and well works effect, the hardware circuit of the DOT is simple, its cost and signal transmission is low and stable.

articleTitle: A Method of Video Quality Assessment for CMMB Video Test Sequences
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Since CMMB is an important application in wireless communication field -- its video quality plays a critical role for widely use. In assessment of video sequence, classic method often applies algebra method in making a compute model, such as PSNR, which often result in difficult for alignment of video sequence numbers and leads to complex computation problems. In this paper, it presents a novel method bases in high dimensional space. The method considers an image as a point in high dimensional space. It uses special kernels to covering some image points from original image, then a noised image is put into space, the method is performed to find the most similar one in high-dimensional space and gives its similarity. Experimental results show that the propose method make the measurement easily and meet the real noised image sequence. The proposed method is constructive and this work provides a way for video quality assessment.

articleTitle: Study on an Improved Single-phase Harmonic Current Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Bases on present harmonic detection algorithms, single-phase load current is decomposed and a novel single-phase current detection algorithm, which is simple, reliable, response quickly and favors the hardware realization, is proposed, in order to solve complexity of algorithm and slow response of common used single-phase harmonic detection methods. Meanwhile, as the method need to use low pass filter, an improved method is is analysed. By increasing time delay unit, the effect of 2nd harmonic was eliminated, and the cut-off frequency of the low-pass filter was increased without adding the filter order. The response time of improved detection was shorten about half period. Correctness and validity of the proposed method were verified through simulating and experiment.

articleTitle: Study on the Relations between Roof Shallow Strata Type and Roof Caving Hidden Danger Level
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In order to explore relationship between the different types of shallow roof, different structure combination of roof strata and the level of roof caving hidden danger. Based on roof stability partition method, using RFPA software, respectively on set a model about Soft-toughening type rock, Soft-brittle type rock, Medium-toughening type rock, Medium strength-Medium stiffness type rock, Hard-toughening type rock and Hard-brittle type rock, get the characteristics of roof deformation and failure at the condition of different types of rock. The results of the study show that the roof caving hidden trouble level of Soft-toughening type rock and Soft-brittle type rock is II level or above level II. The roof caving hidden trouble level of Medium-toughening type rock is will be I level, but Still mainly for II level. The roof caving hidden trouble level of Medium strength-Medium stiffness type rock, Hard-toughening type rock is belong to I level, II level. The roof caving hidden trouble level of Hard-brittle type rock is I level. Rock strength on the roof caving hidden danger level influence power is important than rock stiffness.

articleTitle: Degradation of Tetracycline by Electrochemical Oxidation Using Composite DSA Electrode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The composite ACF-DSA electrode was made on the basis of both commercial DSA anode and ACF electrode so as to degrade organics more effectively and completely. The composite electrode was proved to be more powerful for tetracycline decolorization and mineralization than using the DSA and ACF alone. With the aid of 254 nm ultraviolet irradiation and hydrogen peroxide, the COD removal efficiency was increased by 59.6%. An optimal dosage of hydrogen peroxide was observed for tetracycline degradation using the composite electrode under ultraviolet irradiation. Acidic and alkaline solutions were proved to be favorable for the tetracycline degradation and mineralization. The supporting electrolyte was also a good help during tetracycline degradation. The electrochemical oxidation using the composite ACF-DSA electrode is expected to be highly powerful for organics decolorization and mineralization and has the potential for practical water treatment.

articleTitle: A New Image Registration Method Based on Frame and Gray Information
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this paper, a new registration method that based on shape information and gray information has been introduced to the procedure of CT-MRI registration. In the first, the frames of the two images to be registered were explained by the principle of mechanics decomposition, then we coarsely registered the two images by their frames and as a result the error of the registration was limited in a small region. In the second step, we re-registered the two images that have been coarsely registered by means of maximum mutual information (MMI), and finally an accurate registration result was obtained. The simulation result shows this method is less time consuming and on the other side the registration accuracy is also guaranteed. Finally we successfully applied the present method to register the CT images and MRI images in a patient undergoing neurosurgery.

articleTitle: Study on medium access control protocol in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Medium access control (MAC) protocol is an important component of wireless sensor network protocol, and network performance (such as throughput, capacity, time delay and power consumption, etc) depends on the MAC protocol used, which is also one of the major technical difficulties for wireless sensor network design. This paper points out the main problem of the MAC protocol design for wireless sensor networks, and does some analysis and research on several typical MAC protocols, as well as analyzes the research and application directions of MAC protocols for wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Study on Water-Releasing, Heat-absorbing and Temperature-declining Potential of Six Green Plants in Large-Scale Pig Farm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Physiological indices of six green plants in large scale Pig Farm of Fuxin city were tested by LI-6400 photosynthesis testing system. Furthermore, the water releasing, heat-absorbing and temperature-declining potential of these plants were studied. The results indicated that diurnal change of transpiration rate mostly presents the double-peak curve in May and in July, and the peak value appears in 9:00 and 13:00. It appears single-peak curve in September, and the peak value appears about 11:00. The water-releasing, heat absorbing and temperature-declining potential of six green trees was stronger in June, July and August, and took second place in May, and was lowest in September. The water releasing, heat-absorbing and temperature-declining potential of Populus alba berolinensis was the highest, and followed by Pyrus ussuriensis Miaxim. f., Pyrus ussuriensis Maxim., Populus simonii Carr and Passer montanus saturatus Stejneger, and those of Syringa oblata Lindl were the lowest. The amount of water-releasing of four arbor trees exceeded 1500 g/m2/d, which indicated that the water-releasing, heat absorbing and temperature-declining potential of arbor trees were better than those of shrub trees, and were suitable green trees in large-scale pig farm.

articleTitle: Optimum Ensign of Transmission for Scheme Based on Vague Decisions-Making
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The steps of vague decision-making algorithm are as follows: 1). Establish the scheme sets and evaluation index set, draw the theoretical optimum scheme set, 2). Input original data, 3). transform the original data into vague value data, and obtain vague set presentation of the scheme sets and the optimum scheme, 4). Calculate the similarity measures between the vague set of the scheme sets and vague set of the theoretical optimal scheme, 5). Vague decisions-making. Get results of vague decisions-making by the value of the similarity measures. In this paper, the new formula of similarity measures between vague set which is the indispensable formula of the vague decision-making algorithm is proposed. The practical application cases of optimum ensign of transmission for scheme indicate: vague decision-making algorithm and the new formula of similarity measures are all useful.

Author Keywords: draw the theoretical optimum scheme set

articleTitle: Pilot-scale Study on Enhanced Coagulation Treatment of the Micro-polluted Reservoir Water
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: According to the characteristics of raw water of the micro-polluted reservoir, jar-test and pilot scale experiments were employed respectively for water treatment. The results showed that the particles with large size decreased when ozone pre-oxidation was applied, meanwhile, the organic matters with unsaturated chemical bonds decreased obviously. Moreover, the treatment efficiency of HPAC was better than which of traditional PAC or aluminum sulfate. The results also showed that turbidity, organic matters and coliform could be treated efficiently by ozone pre-oxidation combined with traditional technologies.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Optimization of the Novel Liquid-liquid Separator
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The component structure of inclined plate with a higher separation efficiency was got by experimental study of liquid-liquid separator with different internal components and the influence of the operating parameters on the inclined plate separator separation efficiency was also investigated. Using commercial software FLUENT to optimize the structural parameters of the inclined plate liquid-liquid separator to get the optimal value of the length of inclined plate (700mm) and inclined plate angle (24°).

articleTitle: Discussion the exergy utilization efficiency on GEHP system of the CHCP
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Based on analyzing the exergy utilization efficiency of gas engine-driven heat pump (GEHP) system, the simulation calculation results of the exergy utilization efficiency on different combined heating, cooling and electricity (CHCP) conditions were given. Set up the concept of heat exergy recollection ratio and discussed the influence of heat recollection ratio and heat recollection temperature It gives that the exergy utilization efficiency of GEHP system with heat recollected is better than no heat recollected at operational models, the exergy utilization efficiency increases as exergy utilization efficiency and the rules of heat recollection ratio and heat recollection temperature to exergy utilization efficiency of CHCP system were provided. It shown that the heat recover plays the important action for increases exergy utilization efficiency of GEHP system.

articleTitle: A New Method of Class Centriod Vectors Classification Based on the Feedback
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: It is a great challenge for information technology that how to organize and manage large amount of document data, and find users' interested information quickly and exactly. Text classification can achieve the goal of information distributaries and solve the problem of information disorder, and then it can offer the convenience to users to make decisions. Centroid classifier is one of the most efficient models. Firstly the paper expatiates on the disadvantage of traditional weight calculation method applied in text classification, and then a new method which uses feature selection evaluation function value as a factor to term frequency is proposed. This paper present an improved centroid classifier based on feedback. The main idea of the algorithm is using the misfit samples in the training set to modify the center vectors which are related with them. From test results, the algorithm proposed by the paper is valid.

articleTitle: A Study on the Elimination of Hydrogen Sulfide Odor at Moderate Concentration by Different Stuffings
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The stuffing is not only the support carrier which microbe grows, but also the transfer medium of fluid and gas, and performance of the stuffing influences the removing efficiency of hydrogen sulfide directly. Thus the removing efficiency hydrogen sulfide odor at moderate concentration with different stuffings (Raschig ring, Zeolite and Activated carbon) was studied by the bio-membrane method in this paper. The results are listed as follows: (1) The ranking of removing efficiencies of hydrogen sulfide of the three stuffings is activated carbon>;zeolite>;Raschig ring under the same sprinkling amount, penetrating concentration, temperature or aerated amount. Among the four factors, the biggest effect on the stuffings is aerated amount, while the effect of sprinkling amount is the smallest. (2) When the penetrating concentration is 20mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, the nutrient solution sprinkling amount is 10L/h, the temperature is 30°C and the aerated amount is 0.16m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h, the removing efficiency of three stuffings reaches the highest value.

articleTitle: The Method of the Online Detection that the Accuracy of Three-phase Smart Meter
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: This project uses the methods of integration with respect to instantaneous power, the wave record of instantaneous voltage and current and the laboratory reduction to monitor the accuracy of three-phase smart meter that on working state. And it also uses the idea of double-circuit sampling and measurement to improve the redundancy of the system.

Author Keywords: the wave record of voltage and current

articleTitle: Synthesis, Characterization of Boron and Fluorine Co-doping TiO2 and its Visible Light Photocatalytic Oxidation of 4-Chlorophenol
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Boron and fluorine co-doped TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> powders were prepared by hydrolysis of titanium tetra-n-butyl oxide in a mixed NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F-H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O solution. The resulting powders were characterized by XRD and XPS. The photocatalytic activities of co-doped samples were evaluated by the decomposition of 4-chlorophenol under visible light irradiation. The degradation rate of 4-chlorophenol was enhanced by F-B-codoping TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> under visible tight. The TOC analysis verified that 4-chlorophenol had been mineralized efficiently with F-B-codoping TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> under visible light.

articleTitle: Parameter Effects on SO2 Removal with Coal-slime Scrubbing in Rotating-Stream Tray Scrubber
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> can be removed from flue gas by leaching coal pyrite. In this study, a rotating-stream tray scrubber was used for SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal with coal-slime which was derived from coal washing process. Effects of parameters on SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal were experimentally investigated including liquid-to-gas ratio, gas velocity, slurry retention time, slurry solid content, and cylindrical baffle height. The variations of pH under different operating conditions were also determined and discussed. Results showed that an increase of about 10 percentage points in SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal efficiency could be achieved by properly increasing the value of the above parameters. Furthermore, the variation of leached iron concentration of the slurry demonstrated the continuously leaching of coal pyrite in coal-slime during SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal.

articleTitle: Prediction Modeling for Heat Transfer of Boiler Based on Partial Least-square Regression
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Due to the complexity of heat transfer mechanism, heat transfer model in furnace with simple form and applying to real-time calculation accuracy usually has a low accuracy. By using partial least squares regression (PLSR) method the boiler heat transfer model was established. This method combines the forecasting by means of model with non-model style data connotation analysis, thus, the model by mean of PLSR overcomes multivariable correlativity. The prediction model for boiler heat transfer based on PLSR has high accuracy, clear physical meaning, and more reasonable explanation to heat transfer mechanism of boiler, as compared with the ordinary least-squares regression model. The modeling method presented in this paper can be used for simulation and model-based control system design on ships steam power system and other large power system.

articleTitle: Foresight and Forecasting Technology of Resource Sharing with Authority
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Since the computer was invented, it has being developed for about tens of years. As it is developing, there are lots of technologies which belong to computer technology emerged such as network technology, database technology, embedded technology, and so on. What the aim of these technology invented is for people communicating more convenient and sharing information more easy. Until now, there are still have new things emerging. Such as SOA, Cloud computing they two all has a same character that is make people to share resource more easily. Looking the overall situation, we could find that the main tendency in the development is resource sharing. No doubt, if you want to use resource from Internet or database you should be allowed. That means you should use the resource with authority.

articleTitle: The Mathematical Model for Natural Settling Classification of Flotation Tailings
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In order to discharge the slime with high ash content and thus decrease the middling cycling of column flotation, a classification device was designed employing the principle of natural settling of the particles. Good classification was obtained and more than half of the high ash slime can be discharged as the overflow. A mathematical model was introduced to simulate the partition function with the fish-hook appeared in the experiment results. The model involves a Weibull function and a Gauss function representing the classification and the entrainment, respectively. The fitting results show a good agreement with the experimental results. Some parameters can be significantly related to the operating conditions. Based on these relationships, a comprehensive multi-variant model was established and showed good fitness. The relationships embodied in the comprehensive model are coincident with the traditional classification and settlement theory.

articleTitle: Accumulation of Soluble Organic Nitrogen under Intensive Vegetable Production Pattern in Northeast China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Field experiment was conducted to investigate the accumulation of soluble organic nitrogen under intensive vegetable production pattern in Northeast China. The results showed that the amount of soil soluble organic nitrogen was increased by 114.2% and 184.2% in the treatments M<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and M<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> compared with CK, and its corresponding percent accounting for the total soluble N was increased by 74.9% and 123.7%, respectively (P <; 0.01). This suggested that the substantive application of organic manure significantly elevated the accumulation of soluble organic nitrogen, and then extended its leaching risk into deeper soil layers under the intensive vegetable production process.

articleTitle: The P, S, CI Flame Photometric Sensors Fusion and Intelligent Detection
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Flame photometion analysis technics possess many advantages. In past several decades, flame photometric analysis technics have draw much attention to the inspectoion workers, and has obtained considerable development, particularly on its fusion technique. The main elements of toxicants are the materials which contain P, S, Cl, which has a great meaning for detect them. The textual research expresses. The multi-sensor technology can achieve the detect of harmful materials, especially those contains P, S, Cl.

articleTitle: The Research of Electric Multi-channel Optimized Payment Mode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Based on the proposed electric payment-channel's operation and the requirement of present power company's need, this paper further analysis the true payment data which come from a certain area and according to the optimal method it puts forward a best optimized payment scheme. This study aims at reasonablely planning and scientifically managing the existing electric payment-channels, which can deals with the growing demands of the power users and the developing electricity-service system's needs of the intelligent power grids.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on the Drawing of the Electronic Polluting Area Map
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: With the quantitative analysis of pollution area mapping rules and business functions of the modular design by means of geographic information systems technology, computer software and other key technologies, this paper preliminary makes the overall framework of the standard drawing of electronic pollution area distribution mapping, and proposes to build the hardware and software operating platform, database structure design standards and form of generation of electronic pollution area mapping.

articleTitle: Generalized Hyperbolic-function Method with Computerized Symbolic Computation to the Nizhnik-Novikov-Veselov Equation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In this paper, by the use of the generalized hyperbolic-function method, we obtain some new exact analytic solutions of the Nizhnik-Novikov-Veselov equation, including shocks waves and bells waves solutions.

articleTitle: Thermal and Electrical Analysis of the Anode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Thermal and electrical shocks are the main causes for the anode cracking, which results in severe cell disturbance and higher net carbon consumption. A parametrical finite element analysis (FEA) model is developed to simulate the thermal distribution of an anode after setting. The actual temperature and voltage drop of the anode was measured in industrial cell. The temperature and voltage drop of the anode were analyzed.

articleTitle: Driver Program Development of SC16C754B Based on µ C/OS-II Operating System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: The common development process of hardware driver has been discussed here. The register setup and the hardware connect of SC16C754B has been detailed. The operating system used is μ C/OS-II and the MCU used is LPC2378. The query mode and interrupt mode of data translating has all been detailed. It is a good example of UART hardware development.

articleTitle: On the Evaporation Characteristics of Multi-droplets of Diesel by Experimentation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: In order to study the mutual influence in the process of droplets evaporation, the evaporation phenomena of single droplet, double-droplets and multi-droplets were studied experimentally in this paper. Firstly, the influence of background temperature on single droplet evaporation rate was contrasted to verify the reasonableness of the experimental system. And then, the influence of number of droplets was studied by comparing the value of evaporation rate for each experimental condition. It can be found that when the number of droplets increases, the evaporation rate of droplets decreases.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Remote Monitoring System for Central Heating
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: This paper takes a remote monitoring system of central heating as the object and introduces the system design, system structure, communication and remote control system of heat exchanging station, etc. This system has realized heating network monitoring and heat energy measurement and management of users, changed manual metering, manual management mode of settlement, realized real-time monitoring of heating network and the measurement automation and achieved better economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Narrowing Semantic Gap in Content-based Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Distributed Control and Intelligent Environmental Monitoring
abstract: Due to the low-level image features it utilizes, the semantic gap problem is hard to bridge and performance of CBIR systems is still far away from users' expectation. Image annotation, region-based image retrieval and relevance feedback are three main approaches for narrowing the "semantic gap". In this paper, recent development in these fields are reviewed and some future directions are proposed in the end.
